viewports.result: No horizontal overflow; mobile zone controls, help, full page and modal inspected

checks.name: Empty/offline states
checks.detail: Static local preview without API showed explicit unavailable/empty data with demo actions disabled. No fixture values were injected in the browser.

checks.name: Facility selection
checks.detail: Both food-a and learning-b rendered from service data. All scenario mutations used learning-b; food-a was inspected read-only.

checks.name: Keyboard zone selection
checks.detail: Enter on the Meeting room SVG button changed the selected detail to Meeting room; SVG groups expose labels in the accessibility tree.

checks.name: Metric selection
checks.detail: CO₂ control changed SVG labels/readings/units from airflow to service CO₂ values; Airflow restored.

checks.name: Mobile help
checks.detail: Mobile help icon opened native dialog including simulation limits, ACK/recovery distinction and Korean operator guidance.

checks.name: Error announcement
checks.detail: Stale action rejection appeared inside the active native dialog, focused as an alert. The command was not added.

checks.name: Console
checks.detail: No error logs reported in final live browser check.

checks.name: Static source checks
checks.detail: node --check, unique HTML IDs and known static SVG references, CSS brace balance, and git diff --check passed.

runs.ui_observation: Virtual action progressed through CSE write, device ACK and later observed recovery. UI showed 1 verified outcome. The initial backend version left the run marked running; the command itself was verified.

UI showed 2 of 3 current zones, STALE DATA, no current-run action, and an in-dialog server rejection: Observation is too old for control. An older verified command was not presented as current recovery.
UI showed command timed_out, no device ACK, 0 pending actions, 1 incident and 0 verified outcomes after the deadline.
UI first showed ACKNOWLEDGED while awaiting later observations, then UNRESOLVED after deficient post-ACK observations. Check result refreshed the actual service outcome; recovery stayed unverified.

limits: This is implementation-author QA, not the independent Rubric review.
No certification, physical ventilation performance or health outcome is asserted.
Keyboard/basic accessibility and visual layout were inspected; this is not a comprehensive WCAG conformance audit.
Browser QA covered Chrome; other browsers/assistive-technology combinations remain unverified.
Screenshot and trace captures are timestamped evidence of this local run, not a live-model execution claim.
